head: 16 CATCHES.
THEN THE RABBITS LEARN.
beats.say: My AI wolves catch sixteen. Then the prey learns too.

end_say: Team wolf or team rabbit? Comment.

post.title: My AI wolves got to 38 catches. Then the rabbits learned too
post.caption: My AI wolves went from 16 catches to 38 by gen 16. At gen 19 the rabbits started evolving too. Gen 23: 32. Gen 30: 19. Gen 36: 18. Wolves and rabbits are small neural networks; the best of each get copied with mutations.
post.pinned: Every wolf is a small neural network that steers toward rabbits. From gen 19 the rabbits are neural networks too, and the best escapers get copied with mutations, so both sides evolve.
post.notes: Extra reel (Ansh asked for more, Nov 25). Seed 929, prey_from 19. caught: 1:16 4:33 16:38 19:34 23:32 30:19 36:18. Idea test: relatable/question/reaction = 3 of 4.
